# Travelaxis

> Visit and study visa documentation consultancy for applicants in Pakistan and the UAE: Dubai/UAE visit visas, UK, USA, Schengen/Germany and Australia visit visas, and UK, USA, Australia and Germany study visas (plus an information-only Canada guide). Offices in Dubai and Lahore. Also job seeker visa documentation (UAE, Germany Opportunity Card, Austria, Sweden) for applicants from Pakistan and India, and UAE Golden Visa documentation for Pakistani applicants. Travelaxis does not offer UAE business setup, government services, other UAE residency visas, document attestation or Umrah services. Based in Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE. Content is general information, not legal advice. Travelaxis is a documentation and consultancy service — it does not issue visas or licenses, arrange sponsorship or jobs, guarantee approval, or provide regulated immigration/legal consulting (e.g. Canada Express Entry/PNP, Australia skilled-visa assessment, US H-1B petition filing or family-based immigrant visas); applications are submitted through the relevant country's official government channels.

- [Canada visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/canada-visa-from-pakistan/) — information guide to visit visas and study permits with official IRCC fees; Travelaxis is not an authorized Canadian immigration representative, so paid help for Canada is limited to translation, travel bookings and help using IRCC's online system
- [Australia visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/australia-visa-from-pakistan/) — Visitor, Student, and Partner/Family visa documentation (not skilled-visa points assessment, which requires a MARA-registered agent)
- [USA visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/usa-visa-from-pakistan/) — B1/B2 visitor and F1 student visa documentation, DS-160 review, and interview prep (not H-1B, family-based, or Diversity Visa petitions, which require a US immigration attorney)
- [Germany visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/germany-visa-from-pakistan/) — Student/Ausbildung, Visit/Tourist (Schengen) and Family Reunification visa documentation
- [Germany study visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/study-visa/germany/) — Student/Ausbildung visa requirements and application support
- [Schengen & Germany visit visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/visit-visa/schengen/) — €90 fee, which embassy to apply to, Islamabad/Karachi waiting lists, German Mission document checklist
- [Services for clients in Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/pakistan/) — hub linking Dubai, UK, USA, Schengen/Germany and Australia visa pages, a Canada information guide, and Pakistan-specific guides

## Pakistan-specific guides

- [Start a Business in Dubai from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/start-business-in-dubai-from-pakistan/) — mainland vs freezone, power of attorney signing, State Bank remittance rules, setup costs
- [UAE Family Visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/uae-family-visa-from-pakistan/) — income requirements, tenancy rules, attested marriage/birth certificates
- [UAE Student Visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/uae-student-visa-from-pakistan/) — university sponsorship, IBCC/HEC attestation, O/A-level equivalency
- [UAE Student Visa (general)](https://travelaxis.me/blog/uae-student-visa-guide/) — university sponsorship vs parent-dependent route, eligibility, costs
- [Dubai Visit Visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/dubai-visit-visa-from-pakistan/) — 30/60/90-day durations, sponsor routes, documents, solvency proof
- [USA Visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/usa-visa-from-pakistan/) — DS-160, Embassy Islamabad interview, B1/B2 and F1 documents; explicitly scopes out H-1B petition filing and family-based immigrant visas as requiring a US immigration attorney

## Visit-visa refusal and application guides (for Pakistani applicants)

- [UK Visit Visa Refusal Reasons for Pakistani Applicants](https://travelaxis.me/blog/uk-visit-visa-refusal-reasons-pakistani-applicants/) — the genuine visitor requirement (Appendix V, V 4.2), top refusal reasons, why there is no ordinary appeal, how to reapply
- [How Much Bank Balance for a UK Visit Visa From Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/how-much-bank-balance-uk-visit-visa-pakistan/) — how much to show for your trip, statement rules, the sponsor option, money mistakes to avoid
- [Top Schengen Visa Rejection Reasons for Pakistani Applicants](https://travelaxis.me/blog/schengen-visa-rejection-reasons-pakistani-applicants/) — the 11 official Article 32 refusal codes, bank balance guidance, appeal vs reapply
- [Cover Letter for a Visit Visa: Free Sample & Template](https://travelaxis.me/blog/cover-letter-for-visit-visa-sample-pakistan/) — copy-paste sample and the mistakes that get letters refused
- [Canada Visitor Visa Refusal Reasons for Pakistani Applicants](https://travelaxis.me/blog/canada-visitor-visa-refusal-reasons-pakistani-applicants/) — IRCC's leave-on-time test, ties and funds evidence, refusal letters and officer decision notes, when to reapply

## Study-visa guides (for Pakistani applicants)

- [Germany Student Visa from Pakistan: Blocked Account, Documents & How to Apply](https://travelaxis.me/blog/germany-student-visa-blocked-account-pakistan/) — blocked account, deed of obligation, HEC scholarship, documents the German Mission lists, where to apply
- [Australia Student Visa from Pakistan: The Genuine Student Requirement Explained](https://travelaxis.me/blog/australia-student-visa-genuine-student-requirement-pakistan/) — how the Genuine Student requirement replaced the GTE statement, the 150-word online questions, and the evidence Home Affairs encourages you to attach
